title: Analyst Report AWS named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SCPS
content: Gartner | Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services Download the Gartner report Get started with AWS Amazon Web Services recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services Organizations are accelerating their cloud strategies to drive innovation, modernize applications, and build with AI. Choosing the right strategic cloud platform is critical to achieving business outcomes at scale. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services. We believe this recognition reflects our commitment to delivering the broadest and deepest set of cloud capabilities—from infrastructure and AI to security and operations—so you can build, innovate, and scale with confidence. Download the report to learn: How Gartner evaluates strategic cloud platform providers on completeness of vision and ability to execute Why AWS is positioned as a Leader in this evaluation Key market trends shaping cloud platform strategy, including agentic AI and multicloud The Gartner evaluation of AWS strengths & cautions, among other provider offerings.
